editorial_style: Easy bilingual narration: Telugu sentence structure and connectors with English scientific, legal and programme terms
scope: Sections C and D; every source record reread manually
issues: l9-c-p005 occurs twice, once as fact f005 and once as f006, with identical text and the same combined fact_ids; retain both fact mappings but render the paragraph only once.

Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N., Great Green Wall implementation totals, the Jerdon's Courser acoustic report, CRZ-2019 approval status and June 2026 CRZ recommendation are time-sensitive and require official-source verification at integration.
Pulicat's absence from the Ramsar list is a negative current-list claim and must be checked against the current RSIS list before each edition.
The approximately 730 sacred-grove count is inventory-dependent; never present it as an exhaustive statutory total.
Cycas seshachalamensis Critically Endangered is an author-proposed assessment, not a formal IUCN Red List entry.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Kolleru is a shallow, seasonal freshwater floodplain lake between the Godavari and Krishna deltas. The Budameru and Tammileru bring water into it, while the Upputeru carries water away. By temporarily storing floodwater, the lake moderates floods and supports large numbers of wintering waterbirds. Ramsar designation recognises these existing ecological functions; it did not create them.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Godavari, Krishna deltas మధ్య Kolleru అనే shallow, seasonal freshwater floodplain lake ఉంది. Budameru, Tammileru streams ద్వారా దీనికి నీరు చేరి, Upputeru ద్వారా బయటకు వెళుతుంది. Floodwaterను కొంతకాలం నిల్వచేయడం వల్ల వరద తీవ్రత తగ్గుతుంది; winter seasonలో పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో waterbirdsకు habitat లభిస్తుంది. Ramsar designation ఈ ecological functionsను గుర్తించింది; వాటిని కొత్తగా సృష్టించలేదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: The area figures used for Kolleru answer different questions. Its Ramsar site covers 90,100 hectares, whereas the notified Wildlife Sanctuary covers 308 km². The lake's actual water spread is not fixed and changes by season. A proposed boundary change has no legal effect until the prescribed process is completed; therefore a proposal and a notified boundary must not be treated as the same stage.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Kolleruకు చెప్పే area figures వేర్వేరు questionsకు సమాధానాలు. Ramsar site విస్తీర్ణం 90,100 hectares; notified Wildlife Sanctuary విస్తీర్ణం 308 km². Lakeలో actual water spread మాత్రం seasonను బట్టి మారుతుంది. Prescribed process పూర్తయ్యే వరకు proposed boundary changeకు legal effect ఉండదు. కాబట్టి proposalను notified boundaryగా భావించకూడదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Pulicat is a brackish-water lagoon separated from the Bay of Bengal by the Sriharikota barrier island. Tidal exchange with the sea creates a salinity gradient that varies across the lagoon and through time. Mudflats and seagrass beds support fish and waterbirds. Pulicat is therefore not the same kind of wetland as Kolleru, which is a freshwater floodplain lake.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Pulicat ఒక brackish-water lagoon. Sriharikota barrier island దీన్ని Bay of Bengal నుంచి వేరు చేస్తుంది. Tidesతో seawater లోపలికి, బయటకు కదలడం వల్ల lagoonలో ప్రాంతాన్ని, కాలాన్ని బట్టి మారే salinity gradient ఏర్పడుతుంది. Mudflats, seagrass beds చేపలు, waterbirdsకు habitat ఇస్తాయి. అందువల్ల Pulicat, freshwater floodplain lake అయిన Kolleruతో ఒకే రకమైన wetland కాదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Pulicat is not listed as an Indian Ramsar site in the current Ramsar Sites Information Service. Its legal protection instead comes from separate Wildlife Sanctuary notifications in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu; it is also recognised as an Important Bird and Biodiversity Area. This distinction shows that Ramsar status, statutory protection and biodiversity recognition are separate classifications.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Current Ramsar Sites Information Service listలో Pulicatను Indian Ramsar siteగా చూపలేదు. దీనికి legal protection Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu జారీ చేసిన separate Wildlife Sanctuary notifications ద్వారా వస్తుంది; Important Bird and Biodiversity Areaగా కూడా దీనికి గుర్తింపు ఉంది. అంటే Ramsar status, statutory protection, biodiversity recognition మూడు వేర్వేరు classifications.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Pulicat and Kolleru face conversion of natural wetland into fish or shrimp ponds, nutrient-rich agricultural runoff and reduced freshwater inflow. Reduced inflow changes Kolleru's water level and disturbs Pulicat's salinity gradient. The Wetlands Rules, 2017 exclude ponds constructed specifically for aquaculture from the wetland definition; this can complicate regulation after a natural wetland has already been converted into such ponds.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Natural wetlandను fish లేదా shrimp pondsగా మార్చడం, nutrient-rich agricultural runoff, freshwater inflow తగ్గడం Pulicat, Kolleru ఎదుర్కొనే ప్రధాన pressures. Inflow తగ్గితే Kolleru water level మారుతుంది; Pulicatలో lagoon community ఆధారపడే salinity gradient దెబ్బతింటుంది. Aquaculture కోసమే నిర్మించిన pondsను Wetlands Rules, 2017లో wetland definition నుంచి మినహాయించారు. Natural wetland ఇప్పటికే అలాంటి pondsగా మారిన తర్వాత regulation అమలు చేయడం దీనివల్ల క్లిష్టమవుతుంది.

replacement_paragraphs.en: ISFR 2023 estimated Andhra Pradesh's mangrove cover at 421.43 km², up from 408.42 km² in ISFR 2021. On the all-India comparison of states and Union Territories, Andhra Pradesh ranked fourth. Among mainland east-coast states alone, it ranked second after West Bengal. These are assessment-cycle results and must always be quoted with the relevant ISFR edition.
replacement_paragraphs.te: ISFR 2023 ప్రకారం Andhra Pradesh mangrove cover 421.43 km²; ISFR 2021లో అది 408.42 km². States, Union Territories అన్నింటినీ కలిపిన all-India comparisonలో Andhra Pradesh నాలుగో స్థానంలో ఉంది. Mainland east-coast statesను మాత్రమే పోలిస్తే West Bengal తర్వాత రెండో స్థానంలో ఉంది. ఇవి assessment-cycle results కాబట్టి ISFR editionతో కలిపే quote చేయాలి.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary hosts India's first radio-collaring study of the fishing cat, conducted jointly by the Wildlife Institute of India and the Andhra Pradesh Forest Department. The fishing cat (Prionailurus viverrinus) is Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and receives India's highest tier of legal wildlife protection. Its semi-aquatic adaptations allow it to hunt in wetlands. Tracking this leading mammalian predator in the Godavari mangroves helps reveal how the wetland food web uses the landscape.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Indiaలో fishing catపై మొదటి radio-collaring study Coringa Wildlife Sanctuaryలో జరుగుతోంది. Wildlife Institute of India, Andhra Pradesh Forest Department కలిసి దీన్ని చేపట్టాయి. Fishing cat (Prionailurus viverrinus) IUCN Red Listలో Vulnerable; Indian wildlife lawలో highest protection tier పొందుతుంది. Semi-aquatic adaptations వల్ల wetlandsలో వేటాడగలదు. Godavari mangrovesలో ఈ leading mammalian predator movementను track చేస్తే wetland food web landscapeను ఎలా ఉపయోగిస్తుందో తెలుసుకోవచ్చు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: A survey by Tripathy, Shanker and Choudhury, published in Oryx in 2003, provides an important baseline for olive ridley nesting in Andhra Pradesh. From November 2000 to April 2001 it recorded about 4,000 nests, many near river mouths. Nest density was about 60–100 per kilometre on the northern and central coast but 15–20 per kilometre in the south. The authors therefore described Andhra Pradesh as a dispersed-nesting coast on the migration route towards Odisha, not as a mass-nesting coast.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Tripathy, Shanker, Choudhury survey 2003లో Oryxలో ప్రచురితమైంది; Andhra Pradesh olive ridley nestingకు ఇది ముఖ్యమైన baseline. November 2000–April 2001 మధ్య సుమారు 4,000 nests నమోదయ్యాయి; చాలా nests river mouths దగ్గర ఉన్నాయి. Northern, central coastలో kilometreకు 60–100 nests ఉండగా, southలో 15–20 మాత్రమే ఉన్నాయి. అందువల్ల Andhra Pradeshను mass-nesting coastగా కాక, Odisha వైపు migration routeలో ఉన్న dispersed-nesting coastగా authors పేర్కొన్నారు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: The Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh is a coastal bioshield programme. It restores and establishes mangroves and palmyra belts so that natural vegetation can reduce damage from cyclones, storm surges and coastal erosion. Despite the similar name, it is not Africa's Great Green Wall: the Andhra Pradesh programme builds coastal resilience, while the African initiative addresses land degradation and desertification across the dry Sahel.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh ఒక coastal bioshield programme. Mangroves, palmyra beltsను restore చేసి, కొత్తగా పెంచడం ద్వారా cyclones, storm surges, coastal erosion వల్ల కలిగే నష్టాన్ని natural vegetation తగ్గించాలనేది దీని లక్ష్యం. పేరు ఒకేలా ఉన్నా ఇది Africa Great Green Wall కాదు. Andhra Pradesh programme coastal resilienceను పెంచుతుంది; African initiative dry Sahelలో land degradation, desertificationను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Reports released in 2026 said that more than 13 lakh palmyra seeds had been collected against an initial target of five lakh, and more than 1.65 lakh planted during the season. Reported mangrove restoration covered 740 hectares in 2024–25 and 1,930 hectares in 2025–26. These are dated implementation figures, not permanent ecological outcomes: planting totals, survival and field verification must be distinguished.
replacement_paragraphs.te: 2026 reports ప్రకారం initial target ఐదు లక్షల palmyra seeds కాగా 13 లక్షలకు పైగా సేకరించారు; seasonలో 1.65 లక్షలకు పైగా నాటారు. Mangrove restoration 2024–25లో 740 hectares, 2025–26లో 1,930 hectaresలో జరిగినట్లు report చేశారు. ఇవి dated implementation figures మాత్రమే; permanent ecological outcomes కావు. Seeds collection, planting, survival, field verification అన్నింటినీ వేర్వేరుగా చూడాలి.

replacement_paragraphs.en: In 2025 scientists formally described Hemiphyllodactylus venkatadri from the Tirumala–Seshachalam region as a species new to science. A taxonomic study separated it from known species, assigned a scientific name and published its diagnostic description. This is not a rediscovery: rediscovery means finding again a species that had already been scientifically described but had gone unrecorded for a long period.
replacement_paragraphs.te: 2025లో Tirumala–Seshachalam region నుంచి Hemiphyllodactylus venkatadriని scientists species new to scienceగా formally describe చేశారు. Taxonomic study దాన్ని known species నుంచి వేరు చేసి, scientific name ఇచ్చి, diagnostic descriptionను publish చేసింది. ఇది rediscovery కాదు. Already described species చాలాకాలం record కాకుండా ఉండి మళ్లీ కనిపిస్తే దాన్ని rediscovery అంటారు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Cycas beddomei and red sanders are both endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats, but their trade-control categories differ: Cycas beddomei is in CITES Appendix I and red sanders in Appendix II. Cycas seshachalamensis has an even narrower known range. It was described as a species new to science in 2016 from the Seshachalam foothills of the Tirupati–Chittoor tract, at roughly 200–600 metres elevation; its name refers to the Seshachalam range.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Cycas beddomei, red sanders రెండూ southern Eastern Ghatsకు endemic. అయితే trade-control categories వేరు: Cycas beddomei CITES Appendix Iలో, red sanders Appendix IIలో ఉన్నాయి. Cycas seshachalamensis known range ఇంకా చిన్నది. Tirupati–Chittoor tractలోని Seshachalam foothillsలో సుమారు 200–600 metres elevation నుంచి దీనిని 2016లో species new to scienceగా describe చేశారు. Seshachalam range ఆధారంగానే scientific name వచ్చింది.

replacement_paragraphs.en: A conservation category is meaningful only when its issuing authority is identified. Cycas beddomei's Endangered status comes from a published IUCN Red List assessment. The Critically Endangered status suggested for Cycas seshachalamensis was proposed by the authors of its species-description paper after applying IUCN criteria; it is not a formal IUCN listing. Both indicate concern, but they do not have the same official standing.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Conservation categoryతో పాటు దాన్ని ఇచ్చిన authorityని కూడా చూడాలి. Cycas beddomei Endangered status published IUCN Red List assessment నుంచి వచ్చింది. Cycas seshachalamensisకు Critically Endangered statusను species-description paper authors IUCN criteria apply చేసి propose చేశారు; అది formal IUCN listing కాదు. రెండూ conservation concernను చూపినా వాటి official standing ఒకటే కాదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Jerdon's Courser is Critically Endangered and has been confirmed only in a narrow scrub-forest belt of the Andhra Pradesh Eastern Ghats; no population has been verified elsewhere. Its entire confirmed global range is therefore concentrated in a small habitat within one state, making it a clear example of point endemism. Red sanders and the Venkatadri gecko are additional Andhra Pradesh examples of geographically restricted natural ranges.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Jerdon's Courser Critically Endangered. Andhra Pradesh Eastern Ghatsలోని narrow scrub-forest beltలో మాత్రమే ఇది confirmed అయింది; elsewhere population verify కాలేదు. అంటే entire confirmed global range ఒకే stateలోని small habitatలో కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉంది. అందువల్ల ఇది point endemismకు స్పష్టమైన example. Red sanders, Venkatadri gecko కూడా geographically restricted rangesకు Andhra Pradesh examples.

replacement_paragraphs.en: BirdLife International and Mongabay India reported in September 2025 that an acoustic record from the Lankamalla Hills was the first confirmed evidence of Jerdon's Courser in about two decades. Because the call was recorded outside Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary, it suggested a wider surviving range. However, the finding had not then appeared in a peer-reviewed paper, so it should be treated as a reported indication, not a final scientific revision of the species' range.
replacement_paragraphs.te: September 2025లో BirdLife International, Mongabay India reports ప్రకారం Lankamalla Hills acoustic record దాదాపు రెండు decades తర్వాత Jerdon's Courserకు లభించిన first confirmed evidence. Call Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary బయట record కావడంతో surviving range మరింత విస్తరించి ఉండవచ్చని సూచించింది. అయితే finding అప్పటికి peer-reviewed paperలో publish కాలేదు. కాబట్టి దీన్ని reported indicationగా చూడాలి; species rangeపై final scientific revisionగా కాదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: The Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board forwarded proposals to recognise Veerapuram and Timmamma Marrimanu as Biodiversity Heritage Sites. A proposal or recommendation does not itself create legal status. A site becomes a notified Biodiversity Heritage Site only when the competent government completes the prescribed process and issues a Gazette notification. Until then it must be described as proposed, not notified.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Veerapuram, Timmamma Marrimanuలను Biodiversity Heritage Sitesగా recognise చేయాలనే proposalsను Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board forward చేసింది. Proposal లేదా recommendation వల్ల వెంటనే legal status రాదు. Competent government prescribed process పూర్తిచేసి Gazette notification issue చేసిన తర్వాతే notified Biodiversity Heritage Site అవుతుంది. అప్పటి వరకు వాటిని proposed sitesగానే చెప్పాలి; notified sitesగా కాదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Community-protected sacred groves in Andhra Pradesh are commonly called Pavithravanams. Because they conserve species in their natural habitat, they are a form of in-situ conservation. They are customary community-protected places, however, not statutory protected areas such as national parks or wildlife sanctuaries. About 730 have been documented across the state, many in the Eastern Ghats; this is an approximate inventory, not an exhaustive legal count.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Andhra Pradeshలో communities కాపాడే sacred grovesను సాధారణంగా Pavithravanams అంటారు. Speciesను natural habitatలోనే conserve చేస్తాయి కాబట్టి ఇవి in-situ conservation. అయితే ఇవి customary community-protected places; National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries వంటి statutory protected areas కావు. Stateలో సుమారు 730 groves document అయ్యాయి; వాటిలో చాలా Eastern Ghatsలో ఉన్నాయి. ఇది approximate inventory మాత్రమే; exhaustive legal count కాదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Borra Caves and the Borra sacred grove are in the same locality but are not the same feature. The caves are a limestone karst system in the Ananthagiri–Araku tract; the sacred grove is a separate community-protected forest patch beside the cave and shrine complex. A 2021 study recorded 31 tree species in 28 genera and 20 families, with Combretaceae contributing the most species. Older Visakhapatnam and current Alluri Sitharama Raju district references reflect the 2022 district reorganisation, not different sites.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Borra Caves, Borra sacred grove ఒకే localityలో ఉన్నా ఒకే feature కాదు. Ananthagiri–Araku tract limestoneలో ఏర్పడిన karst system Borra Caves; cave, shrine complex పక్కన community protect చేసే separate forest patch Borra sacred grove. 2021 studyలో 20 families, 28 generaకు చెందిన 31 tree species record అయ్యాయి; Combretaceaeలో అత్యధిక species ఉన్నాయి. Older sourcesలో Visakhapatnam, current referencesలో Alluri Sitharama Raju district కనిపించడం 2022 district reorganisation వల్ల; అవి different sites కావు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Andhra Pradesh launched Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N. on World Wildlife Day, 3 March 2026, to respond to human–wildlife conflict and rescue injured or stranded animals. At launch it had 100 GPS-enabled vehicles—93 response vehicles and seven ambulances—four treatment centres at Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati and Bairluty, AI-assisted warnings and Vajra response teams. These launch-stage numbers are dated; different conflicts still require different preventive measures.
replacement_paragraphs.te: World Wildlife Day అయిన 3 March 2026న Andhra Pradesh Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N.ను launch చేసింది. Human–wildlife conflictకు response ఇవ్వడం, injured లేదా stranded animalsను rescue చేయడం దీని purpose. Launch సమయంలో 100 GPS-enabled vehicles—93 response vehicles, 7 ambulances—ఉన్నాయి. Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati, Bairlutyలో 4 treatment centres, AI-assisted warnings, Vajra response teams కూడా ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి launch-stage dated figures; అన్ని conflictsకు ఒకే preventive measure సరిపోదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: In the three-tier NBA–SBB–BMC framework, the Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board operates at state level. Panchayats and municipalities constitute Biodiversity Management Committees, which prepare People's Biodiversity Registers documenting local biological resources and associated traditional knowledge. Tiger-reserve management additionally involves the Forest Department, NTCA and sometimes neighbouring states. Biodiversity governance is therefore a network of shared responsibilities, not one administrative chain.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Three-tier NBA–SBB–BMC frameworkలో Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board state levelలో పనిచేస్తుంది. Panchayats, municipalities Biodiversity Management Committeesను constitute చేస్తాయి. Local biological resources, వాటితో సంబంధమున్న traditional knowledgeను document చేసే People's Biodiversity Registersను BMCs prepare చేస్తాయి. Tiger Reserve managementలో Forest Department, NTCA, అవసరమైతే neighbouring states కూడా ఉంటాయి. కాబట్టి biodiversity governance ఒక single administrative chain కాదు; shared responsibilities network.

replacement_paragraphs.en: The Andhra Pradesh State Wetland Authority implements the Wetlands Rules at state level. G.O.Rt.No.89 of 24 October 2019 reconstituted it after an earlier 2016 order. Under the prescribed structure, the State Minister is chairperson and the senior environment secretary vice-chairperson; the 2019 order gave the body a three-year term. Its membership list therefore describes that reconstitution period, not necessarily the authority's present composition.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Andhra Pradesh State Wetland Authority state levelలో Wetlands Rulesను implement చేస్తుంది. Earlier 2016 order తర్వాత 24 October 2019 నాటి G.O.Rt.No.89 ద్వారా authorityను reconstitute చేశారు. Prescribed structureలో State Minister chairperson, senior environment secretary vice-chairperson; 2019 orderలో term మూడు సంవత్సరాలు. కాబట్టి ఆ membership list ఆ reconstitution periodకు చెందింది; current composition అని తప్పనిసరిగా భావించకూడదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: The Andhra Pradesh Coastal Zone Management Authority appraises proposals under the CRZ framework and prepares or forwards the State's Coastal Zone Management Plans. In June 2026 it recommended reclassifying the Madhurawada–Bheemunipatnam stretch from CRZ-III B to CRZ-II. NCZMA minutes of 8 May 2026 recorded that the Andhra Pradesh CRZ-2019 plan was still pending: hearings were complete in 12 of 13 coastal districts, with Visakhapatnam remaining. These are dated administrative stages, not permanent status statements.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Andhra Pradesh Coastal Zone Management Authority CRZ frameworkలో proposalsను appraise చేసి, State Coastal Zone Management Plansను prepare లేదా forward చేస్తుంది. June 2026లో Madhurawada–Bheemunipatnam stretchను CRZ-III B నుంచి CRZ-IIగా reclassify చేయాలని recommend చేసింది. 8 May 2026 NCZMA minutes ప్రకారం Andhra Pradesh CRZ-2019 plan ఇంకా pending; 13 coastal districtsలో 12 చోట్ల hearings complete కాగా Visakhapatnam మిగిలింది. ఇవి dated administrative stages మాత్రమే; permanent status statements కావు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh adopted its State symbols through G.O. 59 dated 30 May 2018: blackbuck as State animal, rose-ringed parakeet as State bird, neem as State tree and jasmine as State flower. Telangana's corresponding symbols are spotted deer, Indian roller, Jammi tree and Tangedu flower. The two sets must not be mixed because they belong to different States.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Bifurcation తర్వాత Andhra Pradesh 30 May 2018 నాటి G.O. 59 ద్వారా State symbolsను adopt చేసింది: blackbuck—State animal; rose-ringed parakeet—State bird; neem—State tree; jasmine—State flower. Telanganaలో corresponding symbols spotted deer, Indian roller, Jammi tree, Tangedu flower. ఇవి different Statesకు చెందిన sets కాబట్టి కలపకూడదు.

replacement_paragraphs.en: Andhra Pradesh examples connect general conservation principles with decisions on the ground. Tiger recovery in Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam can protect a large connected habitat but also increases the need to manage human–wildlife encounters. Narrow-range Eastern Ghats species illustrate extinction risk; red sanders shows CITES trade regulation; and the Chenchu example shows why conservation must respect community rights and participation. State institutions translate national law and policy into field action.
replacement_paragraphs.te: Andhra Pradesh examples general conservation principlesను ground-level decisionsతో connect చేస్తాయి. Nagarjunasagar–Srisailamలో tiger recovery large connected habitat protectionకు సహాయపడుతుంది; అదే సమయంలో human–wildlife encountersను manage చేయాల్సిన అవసరం పెరుగుతుంది. Narrow-range Eastern Ghats species extinction riskను చూపుతాయి; red sanders CITES trade regulationను వివరిస్తుంది; Chenchu example conservationలో community rights, participation ఎందుకు అవసరమో గుర్తుచేస్తుంది. National law, policyని field actionగా మార్చేది State institutions.
